name: consultant-crm
description: Study visa consultancy CRM - client, consultant and manager portals

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.fast: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @crm/web && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:start:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @crm/api && npm run build --workspace @crm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
